cohort: The study analyzed data from live births in municipalities in the state of Parana between 2020 and 2022 to assess neonatal near miss rates.
finding: The neonatal near miss rate in Parana was 28.46 per thousand live births, with high-high clusters in specific macro-regions and significant rates among women of black, yellow, and indigenous race/color, as well as those with inadequacies in prenatal care.
